name: agents-skills
description: Lets Claude Code use the skills in .agents/skills/ (where npx skills and other agents put them): each one is copied into .claude/skills/ at session start, kept out of git, and refreshed when a file in it changes or is added.

home.title: Home folder
home.description: Optional. A folder whose .agents/skills are copied into its own .claude/skills too, for example your home folder, so skills installed for every project load as well. Leave empty to copy only the project's.
